author: Rogue Hobbies
description:
I've been into Warhammer and the miniature painting hobby for so long now that I just assume i've seen and heard it all from brush licking to loaded dice and everything else which SHOULD shock anyone! 

But sometimes the Warhammer fandom has a tendency to surprise me... 

I got bored so I ONCE AGAIN opened up the Weird Warhammer Confession booth and invited all you lovely Warhammer (and Wargaming) fans to tell me your guilty secrets, hot takes and strange stories about our favourite hobbies! 

And OH BOY did you guys pull through! 

So settle in and get ready for a particularly weird series of story times!
